_comment: User-visible English strings the backend returns (or bakes into a rendered image) as-is. These belong in the Flutter ARB catalogs; the backend must not grow a second translation system. Generated 2026-10-25 from backend/app. Fields: source (backend module), location (file:line), text, kind (prose|label|template|freetext), reached_by_client (does a shipped client render it today), rendered_by (Flutter file, or null when the backend renders it itself / nothing renders it yet), client_localized (is that Flutter file already using ARB lookups for this string), notes (interpolation variables for prose/template, and the required client action). Regenerate by grepping: every string below came from a literal in a response model, an endpoint payload, or a Pillow draw call.

_kinds.label: Short fixed noun/phrase. Drops straight into an ARB entry with no placeholders.
_kinds.template: Fixed sentence carrying interpolation variables. ARB-able as a message with placeholders; the variables are named in notes.
_kinds.prose: A sentence or paragraph assembled in Python (concatenation or f-string) that reads as written copy. ARB-able only after the assembly moves to the client, or as a message with the whole variable set as placeholders.
_kinds.freetext: Model output or user input. Cannot go in an ARB at all. Needs runtime translation or must be stored canonically and localized at read time.

reasons[] entry from _score_match. Also passed through .capitalize(). No variables.

GET /recommendations/capsule -> data.name, built as f"{season or 'All-season'} capsule". Spanish/Japanese cannot follow the English 'noun + capsule' word order, so this must become an ARB message, not a concatenation. Interpolation variables: season (client-supplied param, may be null) and the literal 'All-season'. No Flutter file references 'capsule' today, so nothing renders it yet.

BAKED INTO THE PNG by Pillow, so no ARB can reach it - the image is the payload (GET /gifts/{id}/artwork). Translating it needs a per-language font for the display face AND a per-language render, i.e. the render becomes language-keyed. Highest-effort item in this inventory; brand marks can reasonably stay English, so decide that explicitly rather than by omission.
Baked into the portrait PNG. Same constraint as above.

Baked into the landscape PNG.

Baked into the landscape PNG footer. Interpolation variable: expiry, formatted with strftime('%b %d, %Y').upper() - an ENGLISH month abbreviation, so the date is untranslatable independently of the surrounding words. Also the sibling literal 'GIFT VOUCHER · NO EXPIRY BEFORE CLAIM' (line 248) carries no variable.

Baked into both PNG variants. Interpolation variable: months. Plural rules matter here (one month / two months / few months in Slavic languages), and English '1 YEAR' collapses 12 months, which some locales would phrase differently.

Fixed occasion greetings baked into the voucher PNG. The docstring explicitly says to keep this in sync with `giftOccasionGreeting` in frontend/src/api/gifts.ts and flutter/lib/features/gifts/models/gift_models.dart - so the SAME string already lives in three places, and only the client copies can be localized. Decide one owner.

detailed_description / description on every extracted item. CANNOT go in an ARB - it is model output. Per the language contract it must stay canonical English (it feeds the image generator and the embedding index), so the CLIENT cannot localize it either. Correct handling is: do not display it as user copy, or send it through runtime translation. Today it is displayed raw.

person_label - a model-written visual cue like 'left, red jacket' used to tell duplicate people apart. Rendered at ai_extraction_widget.dart (label: i.personLabel) and extracted_item_card.dart:person. CANNOT go in an ARB. It is short, positional and low-stakes, which makes it a good first target for on-device translation if that is ever added; otherwise move it out of the UI.

image_description on SyncExtractionResponse (models/ai.py). Parsed into the Flutter model as imageDescription but no widget reads it today, so it is carried, not shown. Same ARB constraint as the other freetext entries.

strings.text: excellent style match / good style compatibility / complementary {cand} for your {source} / matching colors
strings.notes: SmartMatcher._get_match_reasons. No route calls AIService.find_matching_items today (only generate_item_embedding is used), so this is dead-ish code. Listed so it is not missed when someone wires it up: it would emit English reasons through the same reasons[] field the SHIPPED _score_match reasons use.
